Hiring plan 2027 (Example Widgets Inc., synthetic)
Headcount grows from 310 to 352 (+42). Engineering +18, support +12, sales +8, finance +4.
Support hires come first (Q1) because ticket volume rose 35% and first-response time is 9 hours against a 4-hour goal.
Budget: $5.1M including recruiting fees. Two recruiters join in January.
mustCover: support hires first because tickets rose 35% and responses take 9 hours against 4
